tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense and the Director of National Intelligence shall jointly prescribe regulations to carry out the Foreign Languages Program.

tree.heading: Elements of the intelligence community
tree.text: The head of each covered element of the intelligence community shall prescribe regulations to carry out sections 3202 and 3203 of this title with respect to that element including the following:

children.text: Procedures to be utilized for the acceptance of voluntary services under section 3203 of this title.
Procedures and requirements relating to the installation of equipment under section 3203(f) of this title.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 441j–3 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
